public.title: Random Pick with Weight
public.description: This deterministic adaptation replaces random sampling with supplied tickets. Positive integer weights define consecutive half-open ticket ranges starting at zero; weight i occupies weights[i] tickets. For every ticket return its zero-based owning index. Each ticket is between zero and sum(weights)-1. There are 1 to 500 weights, each at most 1000, and 0 to 500 tickets. Random distribution quality is outside this value-only contract.
hints: Find the first cumulative weight strictly greater than the ticket.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Prefix sums define disjoint ticket ranges. Binary search finds the owning range in O(log n) per ticket after O(n) preprocessing.
